claim: Enrico Bartolini al MUDEC received the only 3-Michelin-star rating in Milan in the 2026 Italy Guide
quote: Twenty-six years after Gualtiero Marchesi was first awarded 3 STARS, Enrico Bartolini honours the city of Milan by entering the coveted three-star echelon.

claim: MUDEC tasting menus are 'Best Of' and 'Mudec Experience'; price range €270–350 pp before wine; signature beetroot risotto with Evoluzione gorgonzola
quote: The beetroot risotto with Evoluzione gorgonzola has become an artifact of contemporary Italian cooking, demonstrating Bartolini's gift for combining ingredients that should not work.

claim: Enrico Bartolini al MUDEC is located at Via Tortona 56 on the third floor of the MUDEC museum; contact +39 02 8429 3701
quote: Via Tortona 56, Milan — third floor of the Museo delle Culture

claim: Seta tasting menu priced €180–240 pp; wine pairings €70–180; signatures include risotto alla Milanese with bone marrow and Mediterranean blue lobster with caviar
quote: The risotto alla Milanese with bone marrow is the definitive version of that dish. Nothing else in this city comes close on pure cooking precision.

claim: Seta is at Via Andegari 9 inside the Mandarin Oriental Milan; open dinner Mon–Sat and lunch Thu–Sat; glass-walled courtyard setting
quote: Nestled within the hotel's second courtyard, Seta's timeless design offers the perfect backdrop for Chef Guida's dishes.

claim: Andrea Aprea restaurant is at Corso Venezia 52 (top floor, Fondazione Luigi Rovati); 36-seat capacity, 650-wine cellar; open Tue–Sat dinner
quote: Top floor of the Luigi Rovati Foundation — a space with great scenic impact where a panoramic window opens to Porta Venezia park.

claim: Andrea Aprea signature dishes include Caprese with blown-sugar dome, Cuttlefish diavola, The Selva egg in a custom dome, and Tortello with beef Genovese
quote: A handblown sugar dome containing whipped buffalo mozzarella foam atop intensely flavored preserved tomatoes, olive oil, and fresh basil.

claim: Verso Capitaneo is housed in The Glamore Milano Duomo on the second floor with an open kitchen and three long chef's tables; Capitaneo brothers from Puglia
quote: Three chef's tables look out to welcome guests, a privileged point of view to witness the transformation of raw materials.

claim: Verso Capitaneo earned two Michelin stars within ten months of opening, making it one of Italy's most sought-after reservations; menu from €250
quote: With the achievement of two Michelin stars within ten months of its opening, it has become one of the most sought-after reservations in Italy.

claim: Official Verso Capitaneo online reservation page; phone +39 02 8975 0929
quote: Reserve a table at Verso Ristorante Capitaneo via the official booking page.

claim: D'O is listed in the 2026 Michelin Guide under Cornaredo (not Milan city), holding two stars
quote: D'O — Cornaredo — a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant with two stars in the 2026 Italy selection.

claim: D'O is at Piazza della Chiesa 14, San Pietro all'Olmo, Cornaredo (~15 km west of Milan); concept is cucina pop; tasting menus Molteplicità, Leggerezza (10 courses each), and Esattezza
quote: Chef Davide Oldani is a mature figure in Italian cuisine whose precise and recognisable style encapsulates his two decades of rigorous independent work.

claim: D'O tasting menu price from €155 per person
quote: Menu degustazione a partire da 155 euro

claim: Milan has 4 restaurants with 2 Michelin stars and 1 with 3 stars in the 2026 Italy Guide (announced November 2025 in Parma)
quote: The 2026 Guide has awarded outstanding restaurants in Milano: 4 with 2 stars and 1 restaurant with 3 stars.

claim: MUDEC offers two tasting menu formats plus à la carte; notable off-menu cheese course with five pairings available on request
quote: Two structured tasting formats are offered: Best Of and Mudec Experience, along with à la carte options. An off-menu cheese course featuring five creative cheeses with considered pairings is recommended.

claim: Complete 2026 Milan Michelin lineup: Enrico Bartolini al MUDEC (3 stars), Seta, Andrea Aprea, Verso Capitaneo, D'O (all 2 stars)
quote: Enrico Bartolini al MUDEC received its third Michelin star in 2020, marking Milan's return to three-star status after a 25-year gap.

claim: Verso Capitaneo signature dishes include fennel pollen risotto with morel mushrooms, roasted lamb with senise peppers, veal sweetbread with sea urchins, and panettone soufflé
quote: Fennel pollen risotto with morel mushrooms — wow, what a risotto! Tightened with bolts and locked in at a prominent level.

claim: Andrea Aprea average listed price ~€205 with a 6-course tasting menu (Percorso degustazione sei portate) on TheFork
quote: Percorso degustazione sei portate — average price €205
